description: Answer the red-PR question: is this failure mine or pre-existing? Fetches the failing check runs on the PR head, compares them against the base branch's recent check history, and classifies each failing check as pre-existing, likely-yours, indeterminate (with a stated lean), or external-blocker (deploy/auth failures like Vercel). Call this on any PR with failing CI before spending time debugging.

pr_url.description: Full GitHub PR URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

name: ci_triage
